subject: Pre-demo warmhand: CIO quiet-slot, run-of-show, and technical delegate
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solenex.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: platform.ops@solenex.io
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick pre-demo check: CIO availability + recording preference

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the heads-up on next week’s demo. Our CIO (Rajiv Menon) wants to join for the executive segment but requested a quiet, focused slot (no recording if possible) and a short technical pre-brief for our infra lead. Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can mark the executive portion as non-recorded / internal only, and 2) who on your side will be the technical delegate for the pre-brief so our platform team can sync prior to the demo?

We’ve sketched a tentative agenda — I’ll attach it once we lock the slot. Preferred windows for Rajiv: Thu 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 13:00–14:00 PT.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can lock the CIO’s calendar.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Operations
Solenex
[Attachment: placeholder for agenda request]
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solenex.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 09:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pre-demo check: CIO availability + recording preference

Hi Elena — great to hear Rajiv can join. Short answers up front:

1) We can run the executive segment as non-recorded — we’ll set the demo room to not record and exclude any internal screen recordings at the client’s request. We do ask for a short paper trail (email confirmation like this) for compliance but that’s fine.

2) Technical delegate: Ben Carter (cc’d) will lead the infra pre-brief and sit in on the technical Q&A. Marissa (cc’d) will coordinate logistics and the calendar invite.

Proposed approach:
- Thur 10:00–10:45 PT — Exec walkthrough (quiet slot, non-recorded)
- Thur 10:45–11:15 PT — Technical deep-dive with Ben + your platform team (recording OK for internal playbacks)

If Rajiv prefers Fri 13:00 we can swap, but Thurs gives us the ability to follow-up same day. I’ve attached a baseline run-of-show and a one-page agenda for you to share with Rajiv.

Next steps for you: confirm preferred window and whether Rajiv wants any specific topics front-loaded (data residency, private deployment options, or SLA/uptime).

Thanks — Karthik

[Attachment: solenix_demo_agenda_v1.pdf]
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 14:30:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pre-demo check: CIO availability + recording preference

Karthik / Marissa — I can take the pre-brief. I’ll prepare a 10–12 minute technical overview covering: deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), expected tail-latency profiles for warmstart vs coldstart, and a short note on KV-cache behaviors for multi-tenant workloads.

Can you send me the names/emails of their platform folks so I can include them in the pre-brief calendar invite? Also tagging a small checklist:
- confirm network access (VPC peering or jump-host requirement)
- confirm whether they want the technical segment recorded (we’ll mark exec as no-record)
- collect IP allowlist ranges if they want an interactive test

I’ll assemble slides and a one-page ops checklist.

—Ben
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solenex.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: platform.ops@solenex.io, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pre-demo check: CIO availability + recording preference

Thanks — Thu 10:00–11:15 PT works for Rajiv. He specifically asked for the executive portion to be unrecorded and for a brief (10–15 min) technical pre-brief with your infra lead before the demo. Our platform contacts are: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@solenex.io> (technical lead) and Maya Singh <maya.singh@solenex.io> (security/compliance).

I’ve attached the agenda and a run-of-show — minor edits on timing and a request to front-load the private deployment examples during the exec segment.

Attachments: solenix_demo_agenda_v1.pdf; run_of_show_20280802.xlsx; solenix_demo_invite.ics

See you Thursday — Elena
